name: Switch

source.quote: for $34.25 per share in cash, or approximately $11 billion, including the repayment of outstanding debt.

description: Operator of large data center campuses in Nevada, Arizona, Georgia and Michigan, owned by DigitalBridge and IFM.
explain: Switch runs huge campuses such as its Las Vegas and Reno sites that are increasingly leased for AI. DigitalBridge and IFM took it private for about $11 billion including debt in 2022.
